items.exampleEn: He sat on the bottom stair.
items.exampleZh: 他坐在最下面那一階樓梯上。

items.exampleEn: The car alarm rang for ten minutes.
items.exampleZh: 那個汽車警報器響了十分鐘。

items.exampleEn: Be careful. The stove is very hot.
I need a small screw for my glasses.
items.exampleZh: 我的眼鏡需要一顆小螺絲。

items.exampleEn: Our school has no heating, so we wear coats in class.
items.exampleZh: 我們學校沒有暖氣，所以上課時大家都穿外套。

items.exampleEn: Can you pass me the scissors?
There's some cold juice in the fridge.
The cups are in the cupboard above the sink.
items.exampleZh: 杯子在水槽上方的櫥櫃裡。

items.sentenceEn: Can you put the butter back in the fridge?
items.sentenceZh: 你可以把奶油放回冰箱嗎？

items.audioEn: The heating is too low. Can you turn it up?
items.audioZh: 暖氣開得太弱了，你可以調高一點嗎？
items.questionZh: 說話的人希望對方做什麼？

items.sentenceEn: Be careful on the last stair.
Cut the paper with the scissors.

items.stemEn: I heard the ____ ring at six and got up.
items.stemZh: 我聽到鬧鈴六點響了就起床。

items.stemEn: Don't leave the soup on the ____ too long.

items.passageEn: My grandfather's house is very old. The heating doesn't work well, so in winter he often cooks soup on the stove to keep warm. Last week, a cupboard door fell off because one screw was missing. Grandpa put in a new screw himself, and the door was fine again. "This house is old, but so am I," he said and laughed.
items.passageZh: 我爺爺的房子很老舊。暖氣不太好用，所以冬天他常在爐子上煮湯來取暖。上週，有一扇櫥櫃門掉了下來，因為少了一顆螺絲。爺爺自己裝上一顆新螺絲，櫥櫃門就好了。他笑著說：「這房子很老，我也一樣老啊。」

questions.questionZh: 爺爺冬天為什麼常在爐子上煮湯？

rubricZh: 請求句用原形動詞開頭（例如 Please turn off…）

items.instructionZh: 用 cupboard 造一個句子，說說櫥櫃裡放了什麼。
referenceEn: We keep plates and bowls in the cupboard.
There are some cookies in the kitchen cupboard.
rubricZh: cupboard 是可數名詞（例如 the cupboard、a kitchen cupboard）
「在櫥櫃裡」用 in（例如 in the cupboard）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "My grandfather's house is very old. The heating doesn't work well, so in winter he often cooks soup on the stove to keep warm. Last week, a cupboard door fell off because one screw was missing. Grandpa put in a new screw himself, and the door was fine again. \"This house is old, but so am I,\" he said and laughed."（原 "My grandfather's house is very old. The heating doesn't work well, so in winter he often cooks soup on the stove to keep warm. Last week, a cupboard door fell off because one screw was missing. Grandpa found a new screw and fixed it himself. \"This house is old, but so am I,\" he said and laughed."）
